title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to show more than 999+ in Cue on Role Centers (Show actual numbers instead of 999+)
summary: Cues on Business Central Role Centers display 999+ when values exceed 999 instead of showing actual numbers. This post explains a workaround by using a Decimal data type field instead of Integer, which displays the full value without the limit.
key_points: Integer data type fields in Cues cap display at 999 and show 999+ for larger values
Decimal data type fields display actual amounts without this limitation
Implementation requires adding a Decimal variable to the page and assigning the FlowField value to it
The OnDrillDown trigger must be set to make the Cue interactive and clickable
DecimalPlaces property with 0:0 format prevents decimal point display while using Decimal type
